description: Manage play-facing session controls: recap, verbosity, briefing_order, and tool discovery, distinct from story content and Novel lifecycle. recap accepts an archived session_id, GM-only gm_notes, and an optional compression tier; gm_notes are never returned to a non-GM badge. discover searches names, descriptions, and titles, and detail schema requires query. verbosity is session-scoped; briefing_order persists to the Novel and requires the GM or Editor badge. recap and discover are read-only; a setting is restored by setting it again (no undo snapshot is taken). Use when: recapping play, tuning output verbosity, reordering the briefing, or finding a tool. Do NOT use when: health, audit compaction, event-log, or category operations — use manage_diagnostics; recording story content — use manage_story (action: record).

action.description: recap, verbosity, briefing_order, compress (non-mutating audit summary prompt), compact (GM-only irreversible audit-log compaction), health, context_report (per-section token ledger), subscribe, discover (list/search tools), category (reassign a tool's category), event (append an observation), history (read the event log), verify (compare live state to recorded hashes), replay (read-only event-log inspection), visibility_check (scan a draft for GM-only disclosure), or visibility_audit (recent visibility decisions).

budget_tokens.description: Positive token budget for tier assembly (recap; REQ-592) or for ledger packing (context_report; REQ-610).

detail.description: discover response detail: summary (default) or schema (live input schemas for the matches; requires query; REQ-609).

gm_notes.description: GM-only free-text notes returned only to the Game Master badge (recap).

query.description: Optional search term matched against tool name, description, and title (discover).

session_id.description: Archived session id to include in recap (recap).

name: manage_session

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Session Management
